result.topic_en: Calculations on combining sign characters (e, E, f, F = ±1) in relations of the form 2f = eF + EF + ..., together with a classification of pairs of genus/character symbols (Aa, Ab, Ao, Ba, ...) and a numbered list of such symbols for 1–65, apparently in connection with quadratic or biquadratic residue characters.
